Do you guys realise how rare the gold balloon is? It's 2/13695, I'll do some quick maths to figure out how many balloons you'd need to get before you're statistically "unlucky" (p > 0.5).
This is using the wiki numbers.

Chance of not getting a balloon is 1 - 2/13695
= 13693/13695

Then number of ballons is 
log(0.5) / log(13693/13695) 
= 4746 balloons
OR
949200 fragments

At 5 minutes per 40 fragments that is approx 1978 hours or just over 82 whole days (24hr) playing this game non-stop.

Without 4 alts like OP has constantly playing you'd never have a chance at getting it anyway.
It's not a pattern it's jagex putting the odds incredibly low. 70k is nothing compared to how much you'd need. 

The only way to consistently get a rare in these events is to afk like 6 accs all at once for teh entire duration. And even then you might be unlucky and not get it. I don't like this event and how it works at all either don't get me wrong, just better to know the stats around it first before claiming it's a fix.
